title: Secutec and SOCRadar report theft of personal data in Flemish municipalities, with a hacker using DeepSeek
date_note: npa-ar.com says the firms revealed the breach on Wednesday 25 November; the page gives no earlier day.
summary: Two cybersecurity firms, Secutec and SOCRadar, say personal data of people in Belgium was stolen, including residents and employees of 82 municipalities in Flanders, according to npa-ar.com, which cites Anadolu Agency and Tweakers. Secutec's chief executive is quoted as saying the attacker sent repeated requests to DeepSeek between 6 and 15 November and the model refused only 41. The Belgian Centre for Cybersecurity and the municipalities were notified.
plain: Two security firms say personal data of residents and employees of 82 Flemish municipalities was stolen, and that the attacker used the DeepSeek AI model. Only one outlet's account was read.
exec: Secutec and SOCRadar report theft of personal data in 82 Flemish municipalities, reportedly with an AI model's help.
geo_basis: Region stated by the source (Flanders); no single city given

sources.name: npa-ar.com (Arabic), citing Anadolu Agency and Tweakers

evidence.quote: كشفت شركتان متخصصتان في الأمن السيبراني عن تعرض البيانات الشخصية لنحو 1.2 مليون شخص في بلجيكا للسرقة
طال بيانات سكان وموظفين في 82 بلدية بإقليم فلاندرز
قدم أكثر من 5800 طلب إلى نموذج الذكاء الاصطناعي خلال الفترة من 6 إلى 15 نوفمبر الجاري
فيما رفض النموذج 41 طلبًا فقط، وفق نتائج التحقيق.

validation.note: Only npa-ar.com was read (it relays Anadolu and Tweakers); searches found no second page and no Secutec or SOCRadar original.

review.note: 82 municipalities, 6-15 Nov, 41 refused, date vs npa-ar.com
